From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, Sandra Gomez <sandra.gomez@talentpartners.com>, Marcus Reed <m.reed@acme-security.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Approval request — Security & Compliance hires: Sr Sec Eng (IC5) and GRC Manager

Team —

Following on our hiring plan for Q2/Q3, I'm requesting approvals to extend offers for two priority roles on the security org:

1) Senior Security Engineer (IC5) — candidate: Alex Jones (strong infra + exploit remediation background).
2) GRC Manager — role is newly approved for Q2 to support compliance and audit cadence.

Attached: salary_band_security_2026.xlsx (updated bands), job_desc_grc_manager.docx, and a draft offer for Alex (offer_AlexJones_draft.pdf).

Key asks: 1) headcount sign-off so recruiting can issue offers, 2) confirmation on comp bands and target OTEs, 3) any compliance or background caveats from security that would affect start date.

Budget owner is Neha (Finance) for both roles — liaison is cc'd. Marcus — can you confirm our preferred start/credential checks for the GRC role (e.g., whether the vendor background screening with SC-level checks is required)?

Proposed comp (summary in spreadsheet):
- Sr Sec Eng (IC5): base $210k, target total comp (with equity & bonus) ~$315k.
- GRC Manager: base $150k, target total comp ~$210k.

Timelines: recruiting would like to issue offers this week for Alex (he has a competing timeline).

Thanks — please reply with approvals or constraints.

-Karthik Iyer
VP, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Thanks Karthik — quick clarifying questions before I mark headcount as approved in Workday: 

- Please confirm headcount ticket ID (HR-HEAD-2026-089) and job codes to tie to the req.
- For Alex: is the proposed base of $210k within the IC5 band floor? Need the band reference cell (I couldn't open the sheet on my phone).
- For the GRC Manager: is this a replacement or net-new? HR needs justification for net-new hires for the org plan.

If you can drop the exact band row numbers and confirm net-new vs replacement, I'll mark as pending final finance OK. Also attach the completed candidate compensation worksheet for Alex (total cash, equity grant template).

-Laura Bennett

Laura — thanks. Filling in the details below and re-attaching the spreadsheets with specific band row refs.

- Headcount ticket: HR-HEAD-2026-089 (net-new; budget approved in the Q2 headcount plan).
- Salary band references (see attached spreadsheet): Sr Sec Eng (IC5) maps to Band S5, Band range $195k–$230k. Proposed initial base for Alex = $210,000 (mid-band).
- GRC Manager is net-new (business justification included in the req header of HR ticket). Proposed base $150,000 maps to Band M3.

I've attached: salary_band_security_2026.xlsx (row highlights), offer_AlexJones_draft.pdf (comp lines filled), and job_desc_grc_manager.docx. Candidate comp worksheet (detailed cash + equity) is included as a new tab in the spreadsheet.

Notes on background/security checks: Marcus — per the GRC role, we should do the vendor preferred enhanced screening (includes 7-year employment verification + professional credential checks). For Alex, standard Redwood background + reference checks suffice; candidate is US-based with no export-controlled duties planned.

Recruiting asks to issue the offer by EOD Monday to keep Alex. If finance/HR need a short exec signoff statement, happy to get Rishi to send a one-line approval if you want.

-Karthik
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com

Quick note from the security engineering side —

I reviewed Alex's profile and the proposed comp; IC5 @ $210k base is fine with me (mid-band). A couple of items we need before he starts:
- Confirm interview loop ownership for first 30 days of onboarding (I'll assign a mentor).
- For the GRC Manager, require that their first 90 days include audit readiness work for SOC2 type 2 (we should include this in the JD and onboarding goals).
- Background: if Alex will be working with customer data at product level, ensure we require standard background + sign-off on NDA/classified access flows (recruiting should flag in offer).

Also found one small redline in the GRC JD around vendor escalation responsibilities — updated doc attached (job_desc_gcr_manager_v2.docx).

Approve from SE perspective assuming the screening levels above.

-Marissa Cole
Director, Security Engineering
